bug_fix_verification.root_cause: WebRTC Perfect Negotiation collision detection was broken - it excluded 'have-local-offer' state, causing BOTH peers to process each other's offers simultaneously (rollback + answer deadlock)
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Changed collision detection from (pc.signalingState !== 'stable' && pc.signalingState !== 'have-local-offer') to MDN standard pattern: makingOffer.current || pc.signalingState !== 'stable'
bug_fix_verification.verification_method: Code structure tests verify the correct pattern is present and broken pattern is not used in collision detection
